reiki-cannes.h1: Reiki in Cannes — Private Sessions in English, at Your Home or Mine
reiki-cannes.title: Reiki in Cannes | Private Sessions in English
reiki-cannes.description: Reiki in Cannes, in English — 45-minute private sessions at your apartment, villa or hotel on the Croisette, or at my space in the centre. From €180, same-day often possible.
reiki-cannes.bodyHtml:
I'm based in Cannes, so this is the one place on the coast where you have a choice: I come to you — an apartment in La Californie, a villa in Super-Cannes, a hotel room on the Croisette — or you come to my space in the centre, ten minutes from the Palais and the station. Either way the session is the same: 45 minutes, fully clothed, hands resting lightly on the body, nothing asked of you. In English, Russian or Ukrainian.

Most of the people I see here are international residents and visitors who came for what they'd tried elsewhere and hadn't found: someone who works in their language, comes to them, and doesn't talk in the language of chakras and vibrations.

Where sessions happen in Cannes

In your home. Le Suquet, La Californie, Super-Cannes, the Basse Californie, Le Cannet, La Bocca — all within the included travel area. You need a bed and a door that closes.

In your hotel. The Croisette hotels, the Carlton, the Martinez, the Majestic and the smaller ones behind them. I arrive as a visitor; nobody needs to know why. The shutters down at 3 pm is one of the best rooms on the coast for this.

On your yacht. Port Canto, the Vieux Port, or at anchor in the bay and off the Îles de Lérins — tender pickup from the quay is fine.

At my space. A quiet room in central Cannes. Come to me if you'd rather not have anyone in your home, or if you're passing through. Same price.

Who comes, and for what

Residents who moved here for a partner's job in Sophia or a business in Monaco and haven't quite landed. Visitors during the Festival, MIPIM and the Lions who are running on four hours' sleep and want the fifth day to be different from the first. Families in the villas behind the town. Founders who sold and moved and still can't sleep. People who tried the spa on the Croisette and want something that works on the state rather than the muscles.

What a session is

Forty-five minutes lying on your back, fully clothed. Hands resting lightly on or just above the body from head to feet, in a set sequence. No conversation during, nothing to believe, nothing to do. Most people drop into deep rest within ten minutes; many fall asleep. At the end I let you lie for a moment, then leave you to it. Sleep that night is usually the first thing people notice.

Cannes, specifically

Cannes has a rhythm — the festivals, the summer, the empty weeks of November — and sessions follow it. In festival weeks, same-day slots are the most useful thing I offer. In summer, the yacht sessions and the Arrival Reset for people flying in. In the quiet months, The Renewal for residents who finally have the time. If you land at Nice on a Friday, Terminal 2 to a Cannes hotel is about forty minutes on the A8; a session at 7 pm that evening is ideal.

reiki-cannes.faqHtml:
Questions people ask

Do you offer Reiki in Cannes in English?

Yes — English, Russian and Ukrainian. Sessions at your home, hotel or yacht in Cannes, or at my space in the centre. €180 for 45 minutes.

Where in Cannes do sessions happen?

Anywhere in Cannes, Le Cannet and La Bocca — apartments, villas, hotels on the Croisette, yachts in Port Canto or at anchor. Or at my space near the centre.

Can I book a same-day Reiki session in Cannes?

Often, yes. Message me on WhatsApp with where you are and a window; during festival weeks and summer I keep slots for exactly this.

reiki-nice.h1: Reiki in Nice — English-Speaking Sessions at Your Home or Hotel
reiki-nice.title: Reiki in Nice | English-Speaking Home Sessions
reiki-nice.description: Reiki in Nice, in English — private 45-minute sessions at your apartment, villa or hotel from the Promenade to Mont Boron and Cimiez. €180, travel included.
reiki-nice.bodyHtml:
Nice is thirty minutes from Cannes on the train and forty on the A8, and it's included in the travel area — so a session in Nice costs the same as one in Cannes: €180 for 45 minutes at your home or hotel, in English, Russian or Ukrainian. I don't have a space in Nice; I come to you.

If you searched "reiki nice" you'll have found a dozen French practitioners in cabinets around the centre, most of them good and all of them working in French. What I offer is different in three ways: I work in your language, I come to your home, and I don't ask you to believe anything. The nervous system does the work whether or not you do.

Where sessions happen in Nice

Apartments and villas. The Carré d'Or, Cimiez, Mont Boron, the Port, Fabron, the hills above the Promenade — all fine. Cap de Nice, Villefranche and Beaulieu are a short step further and still included.

Hotels. The Negresco, the Promenade hotels, the smaller ones in the old town. A room with a bed and a closed door.

At the airport end. If you've landed at Terminal 2 and are staying in Nice before moving on, the Arrival Reset in your hotel that evening is the single most useful thing I do for people passing through.

Who comes, and for what

People who chose Nice over Cannes for the city rather than the resort — the English-speaking families in Cimiez, the founders with a company in London and a flat near the Port, the retirees on Mont Boron who came for the light and found they'd brought their nervous system with them. And the people who live between Nice and somewhere else and need sessions that continue from London or Dubai, which mine do.

What a session is

Forty-five minutes lying on your back, fully clothed. Hands resting lightly on or just above the body from head to feet, in a set sequence. No conversation during, nothing to believe, nothing to do. Most people drop into deep rest within ten minutes; many fall asleep. At the end I let you lie for a moment, then leave you to it. Sleep that night is usually the first thing people notice.

Nice, specifically

Nice has more of an English-speaking community than anywhere on the coast except Monaco, and that shows in what people bring: relocation that's gone fine on paper, work that follows them home, children in the International School who are doing brilliantly and falling apart at 6 pm. The sessions are at home for a reason — a body that's just had 45 minutes of deep rest shouldn't then drive the Promenade in August.

reiki-antibes.h1: Reiki in Antibes, Cap d'Antibes and Juan-les-Pins — At Home, in English
reiki-antibes.title: Reiki in Antibes & Cap d'Antibes | At Home, in English
reiki-antibes.description: Reiki in Antibes, Cap d'Antibes and Juan-les-Pins — private in-home sessions in English for residents, families and yacht crew. €180, travel included from Cannes.
reiki-antibes.bodyHtml:
Antibes is twenty minutes from Cannes and the place I come to most after it. The Cap, the old town, Juan-les-Pins, the villas towards Biot — all included in the travel area, so a session here is €180 for 45 minutes at your home, in English, Russian or Ukrainian.

Antibes has two populations that need this more than most: international families in the villas on the Cap and behind the town, and the yachting world around Port Vauban — owners, guests and, in season, crew who haven't had an hour to themselves since June.

Where sessions happen in Antibes

Villas on the Cap. Boulevard du Cap, the Garoupe side, the roads behind the Eden-Roc. A bedroom with the shutters down. I've worked in most of them and none of them needed anything prepared.

Apartments in the old town and Juan-les-Pins. A bed and a closed door; the size of the flat doesn't matter.

Port Vauban and the bay. On board at the quay, or a tender from the port to a boat at anchor off the Cap. A cabin or a shaded deck. There's a piece on how sessions work on a yacht if that's you.

Biot, Villeneuve-Loubet, Vallauris. All included.

Who comes, and for what

Parents whose children are at the international schools and who are holding a household in a country that isn't theirs yet. Founders at Sophia Antipolis who work in English all day and can't switch off in any language. Yacht owners and charter guests who want the first days aboard to be a holiday rather than an adjustment. Crew on changeover day. And a surprising number of people who came to Antibes to recover from something — a sale, a divorce, a hard year — and are finding that the view doesn't do it on its own.

What a session is

Forty-five minutes lying on your back, fully clothed. Hands resting lightly on or just above the body from head to feet, in a set sequence. No conversation during, nothing to believe, nothing to do. Most people drop into deep rest within ten minutes; many fall asleep. At the end I let you lie for a moment, then leave you to it. Sleep that night is usually the first thing people notice.

Antibes, specifically

What people bring in Antibes is very often the nervous system after relocation: everything is fine and the body hasn't noticed. The Cap in September, with the crowds gone and the water still warm, is the easiest place on the coast to start The Renewal — four sessions over a month at home, while the children are at school. In July and August it's the yacht sessions and the Arrival Reset.

Yes — the Cap, Antibes old town, Juan-les-Pins, Biot and Villeneuve-Loubet are all included in the travel area. €180 for 45 minutes at your home.

Yes, at the quay or by tender to anchor. A cabin or shaded deck is all that's needed.

Is Reiki suitable for children in Antibes?

In a short form, fifteen to twenty-five minutes at bedtime with a parent present, always alongside the paediatrician. I usually suggest the parent goes first.

reiki-monaco.h1: Reiki in Monaco — Discreet Sessions in English, at Your Apartment
reiki-monaco.title: Reiki in Monaco | Discreet English Sessions at Home
reiki-monaco.description: Reiki in Monaco — discreet private sessions in English at your apartment in Monte-Carlo, Fontvieille or Larvotto, or at your hotel. From Cannes, with a small travel addition agreed in advance.
reiki-monaco.bodyHtml:
Monaco is an hour from Cannes by car or train, and I come on request — with a small travel addition we agree before booking, so there are no surprises. The session is the same 45 minutes, fully clothed, at your apartment or hotel, in English, Russian or Ukrainian. And it's discreet in the way Monaco needs things to be: I arrive as a visitor, I don't discuss who I see, and nothing about the session is visible from outside the door.

If you searched "reiki monaco" you'll have found very little in English — one practitioner on the east side of the coast and a handful in French. That's why I come.

Where sessions happen in Monaco

Apartments. Monte-Carlo, the Carré d'Or, Larvotto, Fontvieille, La Condamine, the towers above the Port. Concierge buildings are fine — I'm a visitor.

Hotels. The Hermitage, the Hôtel de Paris, the Métropole, the Monte-Carlo Bay. A room with a bed; the rest doesn't matter.

Beausoleil, Cap d'Ail, Roquebrune. Just outside the Principality and included in the same travel arrangement.

On board. Port Hercule, or at anchor off Larvotto. Tender from the port.

Who comes, and for what

People for whom discretion isn't a preference but a requirement — executives, athletes, families with a name. Residents who moved here for the obvious reasons and found that their sleep didn't come with them. Athletes between competitions who know how to rest a muscle and not the system running it. And the people who live between Monaco and London or Dubai and want sessions that continue at a distance, which mine do.

What a session is

Forty-five minutes lying on your back, fully clothed. Hands resting lightly on or just above the body from head to feet, in a set sequence. No conversation during, nothing to believe, nothing to do. Most people drop into deep rest within ten minutes; many fall asleep. At the end I let you lie for a moment, then leave you to it. Sleep that night is usually the first thing people notice.

Monaco, specifically

Monaco's particular thing is that everyone is functioning. Nobody looks tired. The people who come to me here are, almost without exception, doing well by every external measure and closer to empty than they'd say — and they're the most sceptical clients I have, which suits me. The session doesn't need belief. It needs 45 minutes and a closed door, both of which Monaco has in abundance.

Do you offer Reiki in Monaco in English?

Yes — I come from Cannes to your apartment or hotel in Monaco, Beausoleil, Cap d'Ail and Roquebrune. English, Russian, Ukrainian.

€180 for 45 minutes plus a small travel addition from Cannes, agreed in advance. If you're doing a package, we fold it in.

reiki-saint-tropez.h1: Reiki in Saint-Tropez, Ramatuelle and Gassin — Villa and Yacht Sessions in English
reiki-saint-tropez.title: Reiki in Saint-Tropez | Villa & Yacht Sessions in English
reiki-saint-tropez.description: Reiki in Saint-Tropez, Ramatuelle, Gassin and Pampelonne — in-villa and on-board sessions in English during your stay. From Cannes on request, travel agreed in advance.
reiki-saint-tropez.bodyHtml:
Saint-Tropez is an hour and a half from Cannes in June and considerably longer in August, which is why I come on request, with a travel addition agreed before you book. For a single session it's worth it if the first days of your stay matter. For three sessions across a week — Your Week Here — it's the format I'd suggest, because the drive is the same and the week is different.

Sessions are 45 minutes, fully clothed, at your villa or on board, in English, Russian or Ukrainian.

Where sessions happen in Saint-Tropez

Villas. Ramatuelle, Gassin, the roads behind Pampelonne, Les Parcs de Saint-Tropez, the Cap side towards Les Salins. Any bedroom with the shutters down.

On board. The Vieux Port at the quay, or at anchor in the Baie de Pampelonne or off the Cap Camarat — tender pickup from the port or the beach.

Hotels. The Byblos, the Cheval Blanc, La Réserve at Ramatuelle, the smaller ones in the village and on the Route des Plages.

Who comes, and for what

Charter guests and villa parties on a week's stay, who landed at Nice on Saturday, drove down, and would like Tuesday to be a holiday rather than a recovery. Families in the Ramatuelle villas for the summer, where one parent is holding it together and hasn't sat down since the flight. And, in September and October when the peninsula empties, the people who stayed — for whom a session becomes something quieter than a summer service.

What a session is

Forty-five minutes lying on your back, fully clothed. Hands resting lightly on or just above the body from head to feet, in a set sequence. No conversation during, nothing to believe, nothing to do. Most people drop into deep rest within ten minutes; many fall asleep. At the end I let you lie for a moment, then leave you to it. Sleep that night is usually the first thing people notice.

Saint-Tropez, specifically

Saint-Tropez in season is loud, bright and social, which is exactly the environment a nervous system on alert finds hardest to stand down in. The session is the hour that isn't any of those things. Best times: the day after you arrive, the afternoon after a big night, and the evening before you leave. I'll usually combine two or three clients in a day on the peninsula, so if you're flexible on time the travel addition can be shared.

Yes, on request from Cannes, with a travel addition agreed in advance. Villas in Ramatuelle and Gassin, yachts at the port or at anchor, hotels.

reiki-mougins-valbonne.h1: Reiki in Mougins, Valbonne and Sophia Antipolis — Home Sessions for International Families
reiki-mougins-valbonne.title: Reiki in Mougins & Valbonne | Home Sessions, English
reiki-mougins-valbonne.description: Reiki at home in Mougins, Valbonne, Biot and Sophia Antipolis — in-home sessions in English for international families and professionals, twenty minutes from Cannes. €180, travel included.
reiki-mougins-valbonne.bodyHtml:
The villages behind Cannes — Mougins, Valbonne, Biot, Mouans-Sartoux, Roquefort-les-Pins, Châteauneuf — are where most of my in-home sessions happen, because that's where the international families live: ten minutes from Mougins School, the International School of Nice and the CIV at Valbonne, twenty from Sophia Antipolis, forty from the airport. All of it is included in the travel area. €180 for 45 minutes at your home, in English, Russian or Ukrainian.

I'm twenty minutes away for most of these villages and same-day is often possible.

Where sessions happen in Mougins & Valbonne

Villas. Mougins village and the roads towards the golf courses, Valbonne village and the Sophia side, Biot above the glassworks, Mouans-Sartoux, Roquefort, Châteauneuf, Opio, Plascassier. A bedroom with the shutters down against the afternoon — the pines and the pool pump the only sound.

Sophia Antipolis. Early evening at home after the last call, or at my space in Cannes on the way past.

Grasse, Vence, the higher villages. On request, with a small travel addition.

Who comes, and for what

Parents holding a household in a second language while the children settle into a school where half the class is also new. Professionals at Sophia who work in English all day and are braced by 7 pm. Families in their first September here, when the household's nervous system sets its default for the year. And — this is the one I'd underline — the parent who is doing everything right and is closer to empty than they'll say.

What a session is

Forty-five minutes lying on your back, fully clothed. Hands resting lightly on or just above the body from head to feet, in a set sequence. No conversation during, nothing to believe, nothing to do. Most people drop into deep rest within ten minutes; many fall asleep. At the end I let you lie for a moment, then leave you to it. Sleep that night is usually the first thing people notice.

Mougins & Valbonne, specifically

Timing here is about the school day. Drop-off is 8:30, pickup around 4. A session at 10 or at 2 fits inside that window with time to sleep afterwards, which most parents do. Children's sessions, shorter and gentler, can follow at bedtime the same day — always alongside the paediatrician, and usually after the parent has had a few first. Questions people ask

Do you do Reiki at home in Mougins and Valbonne?

Yes — Mougins, Valbonne, Biot, Mouans-Sartoux, Roquefort-les-Pins, Châteauneuf and Opio are all included. €180 for 45 minutes at your home, twenty minutes from Cannes.

What time works for a session with children at school?

Between drop-off and pickup — 10 am or 2 pm both leave time to sleep afterwards. Evening sessions after work for Sophia professionals.

Can my children have sessions too?

Yes, in a short form at bedtime with a parent present, always alongside the paediatrician. I usually suggest the parent starts.
